visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Tai Chih-yuan is captured in a medium close-up, wearing a professional black apron with yellow '林家豬腳' lettering. He gestures broadly with his right hand as he speaks enthusiastically toward the camera. A glistening plate of sliced pork knuckles rests on a red-clothed table in front of him, with bright, warm indoor lighting highlighting the oily texture of the food. (2) The camera cuts to various close-ups of the pork knuckle meat, showing detailed skin and lean layers. Two other male companions, including one in a blue cap, react with high-arousal facial expressions, mouth open, as they prepare to eat. Dynamic variety captions like '高潮點!!' appear in the center of the frame with a white-to-yellow gradient. (3) The scene transitions to a 'new eating method' demonstration. Hands are shown assembling pork slices into pieces of white toast. The background remains a restaurant interior with wooden wall paneling and framed decorations. The lighting remains bright studio-style, emphasizing the food's colors and the characters' excited eye movements. (4) An adult female in an orange polo shirt and white apron enters the frame. She holds a piece of the pork-filled toast, looking at it with a skeptical, slightly furrowed brow. After taking a bite, her eyes widen and she nods with a smile, indicating approval. The camera uses a medium shot to capture her reaction relative to the hosts. (5) All participants are gathered around the table in a group shot. They begin clapping rhythmically while looking at each other and the camera. A large variety caption '期待新菜單!!' occupies the bottom center of the frame, accompanied by energetic hand motions and smiling faces from all four main individuals.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male speaker delivers a high-arousal, projected monologue with clear articulation and a friendly, energetic tone. The background music is a groovy, mid-tempo electronic-pop track with a prominent synth bassline. A digital 'ding' sound effect triggers when variety text overlay appears. (2) Rhythmic chewing and crunching sound effects are heard prominently as the cast members sample the pork. This is layered over a swell in the BGM volume. KID's voice rises in pitch with an excited exclamation, exhibiting high vocal variability and joyful valence. (3) The acoustic environment shifts with a quick 'whoosh' transition sound. Multiple male voices overlap in a casual, excited conversational style discussing the 'toast combo'. The BGM continues with a steady beat, maintaining a high-energy atmosphere. (4) The woman's voice introduces a more subdued tonal quality. A short, intentional silence occurs while she chews, followed by her approving comments with rising intonation, expressing surprise and satisfaction. (5) The audio track concludes with the sound of rhythmic, synchronized clapping from multiple people. The BGM swells to its peak loudness with bright synthesizer chords. The final few seconds include collective laughter and a rapid fade-out.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Presentation -> Experimentation -> Testimonial -> Resolution
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the traditional 'Lin Family Pork Knuckles' by showcasing a humorous and creative 'new eating method' (pork with sweet potato toast) and proving its deliciousness through reactions from both the hosts and an employee.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The characters wear aprons with the brand '林家豬腳' and actively praise the food while filming inside the establishment.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses a high-energy variety show editing style with heavy text overlays and SFX to maintain engagement. The contrast between the skepticism of the employee and her final approval provides social proof for the product.
